summary: Backend-only testing for WORKLY. Ran 43 pytest cases covering seed, auth (login worker/company, register, /auth/me, duplicate & invalid role), auth protection on 11 endpoints (401 without token + invalid token), worker & company dashboards, check-in/dashboard/check-out flow (including double-checkin/double-checkout 400), search (workers for company, jobs for worker, with q filter), conversations list/detail/404, messages (text/voice/document + last_message preview update), contracts list (worker & company), get contract, sign contract (status->active + timeline append + persistence), career (timeline/achievements/training/skills), notifications list & mark-as-read, availability toggle (persistence via /auth/me). All 43/43 passed. No _id leakage observed; password_hash omitted from user payloads. Backend is stable and fully matches the requested feature list.

minor.issue: Returns 400 for wrong credentials; convention is 401 Unauthorized. Not blocking.
Returns 404 both for non-existent conversation AND for conversations where user is not a participant. Fine for privacy but the message 'Conversa não encontrada' may mask authorization failures.

action_items: Consider returning 401 (not 400) for invalid login credentials.
Optional: return 403 (not 404) when user tries to access a conversation they don't participate in, for clearer semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses PyJWT + bcrypt correctly; passwords never leaked (public_user strips password_hash and _id).
All routes correctly prefixed with /api and included via api_router.
MongoDB _id is stripped from all responses (spot-checked in tests).
UUID string ids used consistently; no ObjectId leaked.
Env vars loaded via load_dotenv; no hardcoded secrets in code.
Single-file server.py at 430 lines is acceptable but nearing the 700 line threshold; consider splitting routers if it grows further.
seed_data_creation: Seeded via POST /api/seed at session start (wipes+recreates). Seed returns worker/company demo accounts with password123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Base API = <url>/api. Seed endpoint is idempotent-by-wipe; safe to call at session start. Session-scoped worker_auth and company_auth fixtures provide Bearer headers. Test-created data is prefixed 'TEST_'/'test_'; no explicit cleanup needed as re-seeding wipes.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all tests pass. One initial test failure was a test-side bug (assumed case-preserved email, but backend intentionally lowercases email on register). Fixed in test file.
